governance.rule: D25 applied to the redesign: every value below is used only because this file marks it with a decision the verdict engine accepts (D54, or D53 for values read from config/intelligence-v2.json). Changing a value needs a new decision recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md; tests fail if this file and D54 disagree.

publication.note: A contract 1.5 site build writes verdicts.json and the pages lead with it. Setting include_in_site_build to false needs no code change: the build then has no verdicts.json and the pages are the pre-redesign pages.

tier.low_activity_below_completed.meaning: Low activity: fewer than this many completed projects in the window and no overdue open work (zero projects always is)

tier.weakest_late_above_team_pp.meaning: Weakest: late rate at least this many percentage points above the team late rate

tier.weakest_speed_pct.meaning: Weakest: at least this much slower than peers (%) while also later than the team

tier.watch_late_above_team_pp.meaning: Watch: late rate more than this many percentage points above the team late rate

tier.watch_speed_pct.meaning: Watch: at least this much slower than peers (%)

tier.best_top_share.meaning: Best: score in this top share of ranked Editors, and no dimension worse than the team

score.minimum_completed.meaning: Minimum completed projects in the window to be scored and ranked (below it: a verdict with low confidence, no rank)

score.weight_deadlines.meaning: Score weight of deadlines while Quality has no approved rule

score.weight_speed.meaning: Score weight of speed while Quality has no approved rule

score.weight_volume.meaning: Score weight of volume while Quality has no approved rule

score.weight_quality.meaning: Score weight of Quality once a Quality rule is approved; the other weights then share the rest proportionally

score.neutral.meaning: Points of a dimension exactly at the team level

score.deadline_points_per_pp.meaning: Deadline points per percentage point of late rate below (+) or above (-) the team

score.speed_points_per_pct.meaning: Speed points lost per percent slower than peers (gained per percent faster)

score.volume_points_per_median_multiple.meaning: Volume points per multiple of the ranked Editors' median completed projects above (+) or below (-) the median

confidence.few_projects_below.meaning: Fewer completed projects than this lowers confidence one level (few_projects)

team.critical_late_rate.meaning: Team state critical at or above this late rate

team.critical_overdue.meaning: Team state critical at or above this many open projects past Requested ETA

team.intervention_late_rate.meaning: Team state needs intervention at or above this late rate

team.flat_band_pp.meaning: Team trend is flat when the late rate moved by at most this many percentage points against the previous window

decisions.overview_max.meaning: Decisions shown on the overview (all candidates stay under More details)

display.reasons_min.meaning: Fewest 'why this verdict' reasons per Editor (spec §2: 2–4)

display.reasons_max.meaning: Most 'why this verdict' reasons per Editor (spec §2: 2–4)

decisions.scheduling_runway_share.meaning: Propose a scheduling review when at least this share of late projects started with short runway

display.late_bad_above_team_pp.meaning: Late-rate bar is bad above the team rate plus this many points, warn above the team rate, good otherwise

display.speed_same_band_pct.meaning: Speed within this many percent of peers reads 'Same as team'

display.speed_bad_above_pct.meaning: Slower than peers by more than this reads as bad (warn below it)

precision.rate_digits.meaning: Decimals kept for rates (fractions) in the document

precision.pct_digits.meaning: Decimals kept for percentages and scores in the document

reasoning.material_rate_difference.meaning: A change 'mirrors the team' when it differs from the team's change by less than this (rates, absolute)

reasoning.material_duration_pct.meaning: A change 'mirrors the team' when it differs from the team's change by less than this (durations, relative %)
